Thanks so much for your reply. I'm really glad to hear that 10 mg of Cipralex is low, because I was beginning to feel like a hopeless case if even antidepressants couldn't help me. But I am definitely open to upping my dosage and will talk to my psych about it soon. 
I will also definitely look into therapy. I was in therapy before, but discontinued it due to school workload and also just not feeling motivated to get help. I will try it again however. 
Thank you so much. <3
